summary: Prepare climate projects for appraisal and approval with practical work on design, budgets, results frameworks, and fiduciary readiness. Explore the course.
lede: Climate investment project preparation turns climate priorities into proposals with clear rationale, costs, results and delivery arrangements. For climate and planning officers, public investment managers and project teams, the course develops practical skills in climate-risk screening, options appraisal and costed budget and results-framework design. Participants also practise documenting fiduciary arrangements, implementation responsibilities and approval readiness using tools such as Theory of Change and spreadsheet-based cost analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, appraise, coordinate, or oversee public climate investments and donor-financed programmes. It suits practitioners with some exposure to project planning, public investment, or climate programmes who need to make project documentation more complete and decision-ready.
modules: World Bank ESF and Legal Readiness
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project planning, public investment, climate programmes, or donor-funded delivery is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software such as Microsoft Excel or an equivalent application; no specialist software installation is required.
